summary: MGSV: Joint Operations is an unofficial, fan-made multiplayer project for Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain on PC. The goal is co-op for up to 16 players that still feels like the single-player game.
One player is Venom Snake and hosts the session. Everyone else joins as a soldier chosen from the Mother Base roster. Players join and leave with in-game transitions rather than popping in and out.
The project is built in the open by Hound Protocol, a community development team. It is free, open to contributors, and does not include or distribute any game files.
facts: Soldiers from the Mother Base roster
Steam relay, with direct IP as fallback
Your own copy of MGSV on Steam
principles: Research is done openly and written in our own words.
No game files, cracks or third-party mod code are ever distributed.
Nothing touches Konami online services or anti-cheat.
Anyone can contribute through the contract board.
